evidence.quote:

ductility, achieving yield strength 1518 MPa and ultimate tensile 
strength 1601 MPa, while remaining a ductility of 20.1 %.

evidence.quote:

mechanisms.material_state: cold-rolled and aged at 900 °C (near spherical L12 precipitates)

evidence.quote:
the Orowan bypass mechanism is a leading

mechanisms.name: dislocation pair glide
mechanisms.material_state: cold-rolled and aged at 600 °C (recrystallized, nano-lamellar L12)

evidence.quote:
dislocation pair, sliding together in the same plane, will not affect the localized 
ordering of the precipitates, which makes dislocation pairs preferable 
during the deformation process.

evidence.quote:
the dislocation movement across the phase boundary 
promotes the sliding of long-range dislocations through the alternated 
FCC/L1
2 
lamellae, promoting microcosmically homogeneous plastic 
deformation, which enhances the stability of plastic deformation and 
avoids the early stage of crack initiation, resulting in such excellent 
ductility in A600 MEA
